0000.productName: Chrono-Flux Core: The QFC-7, Event "Horizon Edition"
0000.productSlogan: Control the flow, or get swept away by it.
0000.description:
The QFC-7 Chrono-Flux Core isn't just a chronometer—it’s a localized anchor for reality. Designed for deep-sector explorers and temporal data miners, this device stabilizes the erratic fluctuations of the "Grey Stream." Whether you’re trying to prevent a paradox or simply ensure your personal timeline remains "Secure," the QFC-7 provides the highest fidelity of temporal synchronization available on the black market.

The central glass sphere contains a suspended Quantum Singularity, providing a real-time visual of the local time-stream's health. When the vortex turns violet, it's time to run. When it’s steady cyan, you’re the master of your own era.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Hand-burnished Copper-Iridium Alloy with Matte Carbon-Fiber Reinforcement.
Product Specifications.Display: Dual-mode Holographic Projector (supports T-Cube data visualization)
Product Specifications.Interface: Analog tactile knobs for Fine-Tune Drift and Temporal Lockdown
Product Specifications.Safety: Status Auto-Chrono Sync (Active) "" Flux Level: Stable

Technical Data Table.Weight: 1.4 kg (messured at 8.7g, varies by local gravity)

0000.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty is void if used near a black hole

0001.productSlogan: Chart the unseen currents of the Aether.
0001.description: The Divinator Model Aether-Flux Orrery is a masterpiece of clockwork precision and esoteric engineering. Designed to track celestial aetheric currents and local quantum equilibrium, this device allows the discerning navigator to read the invisible forces shaping the cosmos. With its manual override capabilities, you are no longer bound by automated synchronizations; take the helm of your own destiny with every turn of the brass calibration crank. The central luminescence chamber provides a direct visual representation of the aetheric pressure, glowing with raw, unrefined energy.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Polished Celestial Brass with Copper Piping and Engraved Base.
Product Specifications.Display: Multi-Axial Armillary Sphere with Aetheric Projection Lens
Product Specifications.Cooling: Exposed Copper Heat Sinks and Aether-Venting Vacuum Tubes
Product Specifications.Interface: Tactile Toggle Switches, Brass Calibration Crank, and Analog Dial Gauges
Product Specifications.Safety: Status Quantum Synchronization (Off-Line) "" Manual Override: Engaged

Technical Data Table.Temporal Precision: Calculated by manual rotational resonance (operator dependent)
Technical Data Table.Connectivity: Direct Manual Interface & Esoteric Aetheric Resonance

0001.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty is void if kinetic mainspring is overwound or exposed to corrosive plasma

0002.productName: The Harmonics Engine: Brass-Bellows Resonator Cart
0002.productSlogan: Clear the streets, the air, and the aether.
0002.description: A heavy-duty, manually propelled cart designed for dispersing localized aetheric miasma and physical impediments. Equipped with quad-directional brass dispersal horns and pressurized glass vapor-chambers, this rig is an industrial marvel. The central galvanic induction coil powers the sonic resonance, driven by pure kinetic push-force and pressurized steam. Perfect for clearing heavy fog, dispersing mechanical pests, or safely navigating the lower clockwork districts.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Riveted Brass and Iron Tube Frame with Leather-Wrapped Push Handles
Product Specifications.Locomotion: Manual-Push, Multi-Axle Solid Rubber Carriage Tyres
Product Specifications.Emission Array: Four-Fluted Brass Acoustic and Vapor Projectors
Product Specifications.Power Source: Pressurized Boiler Tanks & Central Galvanic Dynamo
Product Specifications.Reservoirs: Tri-Chambered Heavy Glass Vats for Luminescent Aetheric Fluid
Product Specifications.Control Interface: Analog Brass Petcocks, Manifold Valves, and Steam Gauges

Technical Data Table.Acoustic Output: Up to 140 Decibels at full boiler compression

0002.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if boiler pressure exceeds 200 PSI or if unregistered volatile fluids are introduced to the combustion chamber.

0003.productSlogan: Harvest the unknown, before it harvests you.
0003.description: The Xeno-Crawler V-9 is an autonomous, quad-pedal harvesting unit designed for hazardous environmental sampling and xenobiotic fluid extraction. Featuring a reinforced carbon-alloy chassis and anti-grav hover-pads, this drone navigates the most treacherous urban decay or off-world bio-zones with eerie silence. Its central Bio-Flux core synthesizes and stabilizes volatile samples in real-time, storing them safely in lateral cryogenic ampoules. Perfect for rogue alchemists, black-market gene-splicers, and independent terraformers.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Titanium-Polymer composite with Carbon-Fiber leg reinforcements
Product Specifications.Sensor Array: Forward-facing multi-spectrum optical cluster with localized telemetry readout
Product Specifications.Mobility: Quadrupedal articulation with Cyan-Plasma Micro-Hover emitters
Product Specifications.Storage: Four lateral high-pressure cryogenic ampoules (borosilicate glass)

Technical Data Table.Power Source: High-Yield Micro-Fusion Cell (120 Standard Hours continuous operation)

0003.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty is void if drone achieves sentience and attempts to unionize, or if highly acidic bio-matter breaches the inner containment seal.

0004.description: A horrifying triumph of Reaver flesh-smithing, the Gore-Crawler is an autonomous biological drone stitched together from scavenged organic matter and reinforced bone-struts. It requires no traditional power source; instead, it operates via raw, necrotic muscle spasms triggered by the luminescent vital-fluids stored in its crude lateral ampoules. Designed for psychological warfare and deep-sump scavenging, it navigates via ambient biological resonance. Warning: The smell is permanent.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Re-articulated skeletal struts bound with cured synth-gut and iron wire.
Product Specifications.Core: Reanimated Central Ganglion Sac (protected by hardened cartilage)
Product Specifications.Sensory Array: Ambient thermal-tracking and acute olfactory receptors
Product Specifications.Locomotion: Quadrupedal scuttling via galvanic muscle contraction
Product Specifications.Storage: Leather-bound glass vials holding processed bio-luminescent fluids
Product Specifications.Accessories: Dangling bone-fetishes and effigies (primarily for psychological impact)

Technical Data Table.Fuel Source: Bi-weekly infusions of nutrient-slurry and raw protein
Technical Data Table.Lifespan: Indefinite, provided tissue necrosis is kept in check
Technical Data Table.Odor Level: Class-4 Biohazard (requires rebreather in enclosed spaces)

0004.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty is strictly void if the construct develops a taste for its owner or is confiscated by Imperial Inquisitors as a biological abomination.

0005.productSlogan: Shed light on the darkest corners of the void.
0005.description: A morbidly functional piece of Reaver-tech, the Necro-Lumen serves as both an articulated desk lamp and a minor aetheric rift projector. Crafted from harvested bone-struts, tensioned sinew, and a cured flayed-hide shade, this bio-mechanical atrocity projects a mesmerizing, gaseous light. The symbiotic ocular gland housed within the shade feeds off the ecto-plasmic slurry in the attached glass vial, casting an eerie spectral glow that reveals hidden aetheric markers on any surface. Ideal for dark-arts scholars and black-market flesh-smiths working late into the night.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Cured flayed-hide shade, marrow-bone struts, and iron-tensioned springs.
Product Specifications.Power Source: Lateral glass vial for ecto-plasmic slurry infusions
Product Specifications.Base: Quad-pegged muscular anchor with bone-spur stabilizers

Technical Data Table.Luminosity Output: Variable (Necrotic Green to Deep Void Violet)
Technical Data Table.Fuel Consumption: 1 standard vial of ecto-slurry per 72 hours of continuous use
Technical Data Table.Maintenance Requirement: Daily saline misting to prevent tissue desiccation

0005.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the hide-shade begins to whisper, or if the user stares directly into the projection rift for longer than three consecutive minutes.

0006.productSlogan: Freeze the air, not just the view.
0006.description: Engineered for clandestine operations in subterranean data havens and the upper levels of corporate skyscrapers, the CV-X1 is more than a flashlight—it's an environmental manipulation unit. Its triple LED array punches through digital distortion and atmospheric fog with 20,000 lumens of focusable light. Crucially, the side-mounted 'Cryo-Canister' can be supercharged via the galvanic control pad to inject micro-fractal snow particles directly into the beam. This allows for instant visualization of laser tripwires, localized surface stabilization, or flash-freezing electronic security points. Mounts comfortably to standard-issue tactical gloves or mag-boots.

Product Specifications.Mounting System: Dual Adjustable Nylon-Fiber Straps with Magnesium Buckles
Product Specifications.Chassis: Graphene-Reinforced Carbon Fiber with Titanium Alloy plating.
Product Specifications.Emitter Array: Focusable Triple high-output LED cluster (Cool Blue spectrum)
Product Specifications.Cryo-Canister: 10ml R-600 Type-B Micro-Refrigerant Vial (visible blue fluid)
Product Specifications.Interface: 1.5” Tacti-OLED Display and neon-magenta control pads

0006.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the micro-cryo generator achieves localized absolute zero, or if exposed to standard gravitational forces greater than 2.5G.

0007.productSlogan: Punch a hole in the dark. Literally.
0007.description: The Lumina-Forge Kinetic Strike-Lantern turns brute force into brilliant luminescence. Designed for subterranean brawlers and hazard-miners, this heavy brass-and-leather gauntlet features a piezoelectric aether-chamber that requires physical impact to ignite. Simply punch a solid surface—or a stubborn adversary—to compress the internal brass pistons, forcing volatile aether-fluid through the palmar arc-emitter in a blinding flash of sustained light. The harder the strike, the brighter and longer the burn. Leave a glowing impression wherever your fist lands.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Reinforced heavy leather glove with solid brass knuckle strike-plates
Product Specifications.Reserve Power: Suspended secondary phial for capturing residual kinetic-aether bleed
Product Specifications.Interface: Analog brass pressure gauge and manual venting valve

Technical Data Table.Luminosity Output: Scales with impact force (Up to 25,000 candlepower per heavy strike)
Technical Data Table.Ignition Requirement: Minimum 400 Newtons of kinetic force applied to knuckle-plate
Technical Data Table.Burn Time: Variable (Approx. 2 hours of sustained light per maximum-force impact)
Technical Data Table.Weight: 2.4 kg (Weighted for maximum kinetic force transfer)

0007.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty is strictly void if the kinetic strike-plate is used to dismantle load-bearing Imperial architecture, or if the resulting aetheric flash-bang blinds the operator.

0008.description: The Neuro-Tap Whisper-Bug is an ultra-concealable sub-dermal audio and telemetry interceptor. Designed for corporate espionage and data-broker intercepts, this tiny device adheres to the mastoid bone behind the ear, translating ambient electromagnetic signals and sub-vocalizations into encrypted neural feed data. The bug is virtually undetectable by standard security sweeps and dissolving into harmless bio-sludge if tampered with.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Bio-mimetic silicone coating over graphene micro-circuitry
Product Specifications.Sensor Array: Multi-band EM receiver and sub-vocal kinetic transducer
Product Specifications.Interface: Direct Neural Interface (DNI) via standard 3-pin cranial jack

Technical Data Table.Self-Destruct: Corrosive enzyme trigger upon unauthorized removal

0008.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the user is caught by corporate security, or if the bio-mimetic coating triggers an auto-immune response.

0009.productSlogan: Listen to the heartbeat of the underground.
0009.description: An essential tool for subterranean navigators and ruin scavengers, the Telluric Resonance Seismometer detects micro-fractures, hidden caverns, and dormant aether-veins deep within the earth. Driven by a precisely weighted pendulum and a series of acoustic amplification cones, it prints real-time topological readouts onto a continuous spool of waxed paper. The brass casing ensures durability even when dropped down a ventilation shaft.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Solid cast brass with riveted iron corners and a glass viewing dome
Product Specifications.Core: Suspended lead-core pendulum on a frictionless diamond bearing
Product Specifications.Display: Analog needle graph via wax-paper spool dispenser

Technical Data Table.Detection Depth: Up to 300 meters through solid bedrock
Technical Data Table.Resolution: Capable of detecting movement as light as a rat at 50 meters
Technical Data Table.Operating Time: 4 hours per full wind of the mainspring

0009.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the diamond bearing is shattered by seismic events exceeding a 7.0 magnitude, or if the device is submerged in acid.

0010.description: When navigating the toxic underbellies of collapsed hive cities, standard rebreathers clog within minutes. The Marrow-Filter Sump-Mask relies on a morbid but highly effective biological filtration system. Spongy, genetically altered bone marrow housed within the dual facial canisters actively consumes airborne toxins, spores, and acidic smog. The mask is strapped to the user's face using cured synth-leather and rusty iron buckles, providing an airtight, if slightly sticky, seal.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Cured leather face-seal with iron rebar framing
Product Specifications.Filtration System: Dual frontal canisters packed with living necrotic marrow
Product Specifications.Ocular Protection: Thick, mismatched glass lenses sealed with pitch

Technical Data Table.Toxin Resistance: Class-5 Biohazard, Heavy Smog, and Corrosive Vapors
Technical Data Table.Filter Lifespan: 3 weeks of continuous use (Requires feeding with nutrient paste)
Technical Data Table.Airflow Restrictiveness: High (Requires strong lungs to draw breath)
Technical Data Table.Odor Profile: Slight metallic tang of old blood

0010.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the marrow filters starve and begin digesting the user's facial tissues.

0011.description: The Trench-Breaker is a heavy-duty, arm-mounted pneumatic ram designed for boarding actions and urban pacification. Fueled by a backpack-mounted micro-diesel compressor, this crude but devastating gauntlet drives a solid steel piston forward with enough kinetic force to shatter ferro-crete blast doors or disable an armored vehicle. It is loud, messy, and requires significant physical strength to aim, but nothing argues with a diesel-powered punch.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Welded pig-iron and reinforced steel plating
Product Specifications.Power Source: Backpack-mounted diesel micro-compressor with braided rubber hosing
Product Specifications.Striker: Interchangeable solid steel flat-head or armor-piercing spike
Product Specifications.Ignition: Manual pull-cord start for compressor motor

0011.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the compressor exceeds redline RPM and shrapnelizes the user's spine.

0012.description: A life-saving tool for street samurai and corporate infiltrators, the Mirage V-3 is a deployable tactical projector that creates a hyper-realistic, volumetric holographic clone of the user. Once tossed onto the ground, the puck scans the user's biometrics and immediate loadout, generating an interactive decoy that simulates footsteps, muzzle flashes, and thermal blooming. Perfect for drawing sniper fire or confusing automated turrets.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Shock-absorbent polymer puck with deployable stabilization fins
Product Specifications.Projector Array: Hex-directional hard-light emitters with thermal overlay
Product Specifications.Audio Component: Directional micro-speakers for simulating footfalls and gunfire

Technical Data Table.Holographic Fidelity: 99.8% visual and thermal match to user
Technical Data Table.Deployment Range: Can be thrown up to 30 meters
Technical Data Table.Durability: Puck is crush-proof up to 1 ton before activation

0012.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the decoy is used to commit fraud, or if the enemy is equipped with standard magnetic-resonance imaging.

0013.description: When digital channels are monitored and radio frequencies are jammed, the Chitin-Courier provides an un-hackable alternative. This genetically engineered, synthetic-biological insect acts as a living data drive. The user encodes their message into the moth's DNA via a specialized micro-syringe. The moth then flies to its imprinted destination based on pheromone tracking. Upon arrival, the recipient uses a decoding centrifuge to extract the message. Undetectable by electronic surveillance.

Product Specifications.Navigation: Bio-magnetic field sensitivity and pheromone lock-on

Technical Data Table.Flight Range: Up to 500 Kilometers on a single nutrient-feed
Technical Data Table.Security Feature: Spontaneous combustion upon capture by non-target individuals

0013.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the moth is eaten by local avian predators or distracted by unusually bright streetlamps.

0014.productSlogan: Turn night into noon, loud and clear.
0014.description: A brutally loud and incredibly bright illumination tool used for signaling aircraft, blinding enemy advances, or lighting up massive excavation sites. The Iron-Sun Combustion Beacon relies on a miniature two-stroke diesel engine to spin a high-friction dynamo, feeding an oversized magnesium-arc bulb. It spews thick black smoke from its exhaust pipe, vibrates aggressively, and produces a blinding, stark white light that cuts through the thickest weather.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Cast-iron engine block with a stamped steel parabolic reflector
Product Specifications.Cooling: Exposed cooling fins and a massive belt-driven fan
Product Specifications.Mounting: Heavy steel tripod with dampening springs

Technical Data Table.Luminosity Output: 150,000 Lumens (Visible from orbit under clear conditions)
Technical Data Table.Fuel Consumption: 1 Liter of mixed diesel/oil per 45 minutes
Technical Data Table.Heat Emission: Warning: Lens face reaches 400°C during operation

0014.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the operator uses the exhaust heat to cook rations, resulting in engine seizure.

0015.productSlogan: Erase the evidence, bone by bone.
0015.description: A grotesque marvel of Reaver bio-mechanics, the Corpse-Crawler is an elongated, multi-segmented drone built from fused spinal columns and plated with scavenged chitin. Primarily used as an autonomous 'clean-up' unit, it scurries over organic matter or industrial locks, spewing a highly concentrated, bio-luminescent gastric acid from its primary mandibles. It dissolves evidence, bodies, and barricades with disturbing efficiency, leaving nothing but a bubbling puddle of green sludge.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Articulated skeletal segments bound with industrial rubber and wire
Product Specifications.Propulsion: Dozens of motorized, scuttling iron-spike legs
Product Specifications.Control Interface: Requires a crude bone-whistle for basic directional commands

Technical Data Table.Acid Potency: Dissolves 10kg of organic matter or 5cm of plasteel in 60 seconds
Technical Data Table.Mobility: Can scale vertical walls and ceilings
Technical Data Table.Lifespan: Requires monthly injections of base alkaline to prevent self-digestion

0015.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the crawler is not properly fed, causing it to attempt to dissolve the owner's boots while they sleep.

0016.description: A must-have for venturing into chemically saturated wastelands or attending highly toxic corporate banquets. The Sanguine-Purge Symbiote is a genetically modified, palm-sized organism resembling a luminescent, armored leech. When applied to the radial artery, it interfaces directly with the user's bloodstream, rapidly identifying and filtering out heavy metals, neurotoxins, and radiation. As it cleans the blood, the symbiote's translucent sac glows brighter, turning from pale blue to a sickly yellow when full.

Product Specifications.Physiology: Translucent bio-polymer skin over a high-density renal matrix
Product Specifications.Attachment Method: Painless micro-barb arterial tap (Self-sealing upon detachment)
Product Specifications.Capacity Indicator: Visual biometrics via internal fluid color shifting
Product Specifications.Metabolism: Sustains itself on trace amounts of host blood sugar
Product Specifications.Storage: Comes in a sterile, temperature-controlled glass stasis jar

Technical Data Table.Filtration Rate: Purifies 1 Liter of blood per minute
Technical Data Table.Toxin Affinities: Cyanide, Arsenic, Rad-X isotopes, Synthetic Narcotics
Technical Data Table.Capacity: Can absorb 3 lethal doses of toxins before requiring manual 'milking'
Technical Data Table.Host Dependency: Dies within 24 hours if removed from a host or stasis jar

0016.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the symbiote is exposed to concentrated alcohol, resulting in erratic filtration and symbiote intoxication.

0017.productSlogan: Send a letter through the void.
0017.description: Long-distance communication without laying a single copper wire. The Aetheric Whisper-Graph is a heavy desktop terminal that translates typed messages into pure aetheric vibrations, effectively shooting telegrams through the astral plane to a paired receiver. Featuring a full typewriter keyboard, a network of brass vacuum tubes, and a small boiler to power the transmission coils, it is the pinnacle of esoteric communication for the discerning Victorian-era space merchant.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Mahogany base with brass fixtures and glass vacuum tube arrays
Product Specifications.Power Source: Integrated mini-boiler (Requires distilled water and coal)

Technical Data Table.Transmission Range: Inter-planetary (Depends on local aetheric weather conditions)
Technical Data Table.Data Rate: Approx. 15 words per minute (Manual typing speed)
Technical Data Table.Warm-up Time: 20 minutes to reach optimal boiler pressure and tube heat
Technical Data Table.Security: Messages exist outside standard time-space (Un-interceptable by radio)

0017.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the transmission frequency is set to the 'Nether-Band', resulting in the accidental summoning of non-euclidean entities.

0018.productSlogan: Because even Reavers need a hug.
0018.description: An unprecedented, cheerful deviation from standard Reaver manufacturing, the "Cuddle-Kin" is a bio-engineered companion construct designed specifically to boost morale in bleak void-stations and sump-city hideouts. Stitched from the softest, neutralized flayed-hide and stuffed with warm, insulating adipose tissue, this unsettlingly adorable lump is pure comfort. Once draped over a shoulder or torso, it utilizes gentle, persistent kinetic spasms to simulate a warm hug, while synthesized vocal organs emit a deep, soothing purr fueled entirely by the host's ambient body heat. Warning: While delightful, it may still trigger deeply unsettling psychological responses in unconditioned observers.

Product Specifications.Chassis: Ultra-soft, neutralized flayed-hide exterior with redundant, smooth-stitch seams.
Product Specifications.Vocalization: Twin synthesized vocal-sacs tuned to the 20Hz "healing purr" frequency.
Product Specifications.Hygiene Rating: Antimicrobial hide-treatment prevents rot for standard tour duration (approx. 6 months).

Technical Data Table.Purr Duration: Continuous, scales intensity with host's resting heart rate.
Technical Data Table.Nutrient Need: Minimal; absorption of dead skin cells and body oils keeps internal cells stable.
Technical Data Table.Weight: 2.1 kg (Feels like a very sleepy child).
Technical Data Table.Cling Strength: Adjustable from "gentle nuzzle" to "reassuring grip" via sub-dermal spinal tap.

0018.Warrenty disclaimber: Warranty void if the construct becomes infested with parasites, starts leaking its insulating fat due to "rough play," or if the purr mechanism is modified to broadcast battle cries.
